name: Quarkleads
author: nitinkraghav

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress contact forms to the Quarkleads platform.

  • View logs of API requests and errors.
  • Admin panel integration.
  • Lightweight and secure.
  • WP-Cron based cleanup system.

External services

This plugin connects to an external service provided by QuarkLeads in order to send and synchronize form submissions with the QuarkLeads system.

  • Service: QuarkLeads API (https://server.quarkleads.in)
  • What data is sent: When a form is submitted, the plugin sends user-provided data such as name, email, and phone number, along with integration-related metadata required for synchronization.
  • When data is sent: Only when forms that you have explicitly mapped in the plugin settings are submitted by site visitors.
  • Purpose: To allow you to forward form submission data to your QuarkLeads account for lead management and automation.
  • Privacy & Terms:
    • QuarkLeads Terms of Service
    • QuarkLeads Privacy Policy

No other external domains are contacted by this plugin.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Quarkleads API under the admin menu.
  4. Configure your credentials and start managing leads.
sections.faq:
Does this support Contact Form 7?

Coming soon. Currently integrated with built-in form handlers.

Does it store leads locally?

Your form data will be stored locally by your respective form plugin or code but this plugin does not store any data locally. Leads are pushed directly to the Quarkleads panel through this plugin and Quarkleads API. API logs are kept for forever or as configured by you 10–30 days.
